csv_project_name: Term Contract Design for 2026-2029 Non-Bridge Structural
csv_scope_of_work: The Montana Department of Transportation is accepting proposals from consulting firms interested in a term contract for performing design and review services of structural, non-bridge items on an as-needed basis. The scope of work includes providing design and review services of structural, non-bridge items on an as-needed basis through a term contract(s) via term assignment(s). Work may range from both design during preconstruction and review during construction of various non-bridge structural items on MDT projects including, but not limited to: Retaining walls Large culverts (box culverts, structural steel plate pipes, etc.) Various foundations (typically for signals, sign bridges and cantilever signs, etc.) RWIS (Road Weather Information System) infrastructure Pedestrian rail, safety rail, etc. Luminaire structural design Traffic signals (structure and foundation) VMS supports (structure and foundation) Cantilever sign support (structure and foundation) Sign bridge support (structure and foundation) Reinforced concrete design and analysis Other miscellaneous structural items
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Sanitation Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Term Contract Design for 2026-2029 Non-Bridge Structural
short_description: On-call structural design and review services for various non-bridge highway structures in Montana.
project_scope: As-needed term contract for design and review of non-bridge structural items on Montana Department of Transportation projects. Typical tasks include retaining walls; large culverts such as box culverts and structural steel plate pipes; foundations for signals, sign bridges and cantilever signs; RWIS infrastructure; pedestrian rail and safety rail; luminaire structures; traffic signal structures and foundations; VMS supports; cantilever sign supports; sign bridge supports; reinforced concrete design and analysis; and other miscellaneous structural items. Work covers both preconstruction design and construction-phase review.
services: Structural engineering design and review services under a renewable term contract; preconstruction design and construction review for non-bridge highway structures; potentially multidisciplinary support including civil, geotechnical, hydraulics, traffic design, stormwater, environmental, and planning disciplines.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering for transportation-related non-bridge structures, which overlaps partly with sbp expertise.
- Scope contains sign bridges, cantilever supports, retaining walls, large culverts, and miscellaneous structural items.
- However, this is an on-call term contract rather than a defined flagship project.
- No major long-span bridge, roof, stadium, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
- Broad multidisciplinary highway support reduces strategic fit.
- Potentially useful for collaboration opportunities, but overall only moderately relevant.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice is for an as-needed term contract covering multiple future assignments, so a realistic total construction cost cannot be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee, contract value, upset limit, or estimated engineering budget is stated in the source. Because this is an on-call renewable term contract with undefined future assignments, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Consulting firms are sought for structural, non-bridge design and review services on an as-needed basis. Requested disciplines include structural engineering, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, traffic design engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, sanitation engineering, landscape architecture, and urban studies/planning/design. No explicit minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Montana Department of Transportation, Helena, Montana, USA. Contact: Kelly Williams. Phone: 406-444-7964. Fax: 406-444-7685. Email: kwilliams@mt.gov. Website: https://www.mdt.mt.gov/business/consulting/rfq.aspx
notes: Federally funded solicitation. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Contract duration: 36-month base period with 24-month renewal option; renewable term contract. Target market listed as Streets/Highways. This is explicitly a non-bridge structural term contract.
